public_rationale: Zitron said LLMs will not 'magically sprout new capabilities because' more money went into them. Read as he wrote it, this denies that money by itself, with no other cause, creates new abilities. Any later gain in ability can be put down to research and engineering rather than to magic. So no outcome could prove him wrong, and none could prove him right. Spending well above another $150 billion did happen, but that does not test the claim. Treating this as a broad forecast that LLMs would gain no new abilities would stretch his words. An earlier reviewer flagged that reading as unfair to him.
limitations: Some readers may take the sentence as a broad prediction that LLMs would not gain new abilities. That reading is not used here because it drops the 'magically' qualifier.
